scope: Separate default-off device-local permission enables an explicit open-in-application action on the existing chat preview. This opens the currently authorized channel in the main application; it is not an overlay composer and never sends messages.

An independent nonfocusable shaped 88x20 native child displays only the action control and opaque session. No chat text or channel identifiers are delivered to that child. Native validates sender, main frame, actual button hit, cooldown, visibility, ready chat, consent and current session before requesting confirmation.

Trusted main renderer resolves its target from current stores, not the native payload. Account/login generation, server/channel membership, loaded privacy/block state, message-window ownership and exact successful permission sources are checked before and after native confirmation. Missing override data is not treated as a successfully loaded empty list.

Native confirmation consumes a one-shot five-second intent and then restores/shows/focuses the main window. Pending requests are retired by session rotation, revoked consent, hidden widgets or destroyed surfaces. Failed requests can be retried; no success toast claims a message was sent.

Layout setup and auth owner/generation boundaries queue blank native snapshots without waiting for React passive effects. Old publisher effects are scope-fenced. Native overlay teardown also runs on main renderer crash, main-frame document reload/navigation and actual window destruction, but not same-document navigation, subframe navigation or close-to-tray.
